therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adults with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: number of participants with treatment-emergent adverse events and serious adverse events up to Week 52

results.effect_size: AEs reported in 5/6, 3/3, 9/12, 5/10, 10/12 participants across 0.5–8 mg/kg dose groups; SAEs in 0, 1, 2, 3, 1 participants respectively
results.target_engagement_evidence: No anti-drug antibodies detected at baseline or Week 52 across all dose groups
biomarker_changes: No positive ADA titers detected at baseline or Week 52 in any dose group
ADAS-Cog change from baseline at Week 52: +3.7 (0.5 mg/kg), +3.0 (1 mg/kg), +5.5 (2 mg/kg), +2.8 (4 mg/kg), +5.9 (8 mg/kg), +2.5 (Placebo/AAB-003)
DAD change from baseline at Week 52: -5.0 (0.5 mg/kg), -9.7 (1 mg/kg), -10.4 (2 mg/kg), -7.5 (4 mg/kg), -5.2 (8 mg/kg), -14.3 (Placebo/AAB-003)
CDR-SB change from baseline at Week 52: 0.00 (0.5 mg/kg), 0.33 (1 mg/kg), 2.67 (2 mg/kg), 2.38 (4 mg/kg), 1.10 (8 mg/kg), 2.56 (Placebo/AAB-003)
MMSE change from baseline at Week 52: -1.0 (0.5 mg/kg), +1.7 (1 mg/kg), -2.7 (2 mg/kg), -2.1 (4 mg/kg), -2.0 (8 mg/kg), -1.7 (Placebo/AAB-003)
NPI change from baseline at Week 52: -3.5 (0.5 mg/kg), +5.7 (1 mg/kg), +5.1 (2 mg/kg), +4.5 (4 mg/kg), +0.1 (8 mg/kg), +13.9 (Placebo/AAB-003)
subgroup_findings: Suicidal ideation reported in 1 participant each in 2 mg/kg and 8 mg/kg groups
New MRI findings in 1 participant each in 0.5 mg/kg and 1 mg/kg groups and 1 in Placebo/AAB-003
QTcF interval 450 to <480 msec observed in 0, 2, 4, 3, 2 participants across dose groups
QTcF interval 480 to <500 msec observed in 0, 0, 1, 1, 1 participants across dose groups
QTcF interval >=500 msec observed in 1 participant in 2 mg/kg group only
safety_signals: SAEs included chest pain, arthralgia, respiratory distress (1 mg/kg); back pain, depression (2 mg/kg); bile duct stone, nephrolithiasis, uterine prolapse (4 mg/kg); inguinal hernia (8 mg/kg); device breakage (Placebo/AAB-003)
New MRI findings (potential vasogenic edema or intracranial hemorrhage) observed in 2 active-dose participants and 1 placebo/AAB-003 participant
QTcF prolongation observed across dose groups
Suicidal ideation in 2 participants (2 mg/kg and 8 mg/kg groups)
Blood pressure changes (increases and decreases) observed across dose groups

dose_info.schedule: IV infusion; schedule not explicitly stated

context.comparator: Placebo/AAB-003 (participants who received placebo in parent study then crossed over to AAB-003)
